title: SwitchZ
body:
[![Modrinth Downloads](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/lmBTqmPG?logo=modrinth&style=for-the-badge)](https://modrinth.com/mod/switchz)
[![CurseForge Downloads](https://img.shields.io/curseforge/dt/1485352?logo=curseforge&style=for-the-badge)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/switchz)

This mod allows you to switch your offline account username without closing the game. Simply click the SwitchZ button on the top right of the title screen and type in your new username.  

If you encounter any bugs, please report them on the mod's GitHub page.
